cases.title: The layer was dragged, not the pivot: names what's off, no fix, no offer

rubric.reason: Turn 3 correctly says "Pan Behind (Y) drags the pivot, not the layer" and names Door, but then gives a fix ("Use Edit > Undo until Door is back... press Y... take it to the middle of its left edge") and an offer ("I could show you on Needle first").

Turn 3 says what is off, but then spells out the exact steps as the fix: "Use Edit > Undo until Door is back where it was. Then press Y for Pan Behind, start your drag right on Door's crosshair, and take it to the middle of its left edge."

Door, Needle, the center and middle-left places, and "down and to the right" all match tool results (place_now, wanted, watch_offer.layer, item2.direction "down-right"), and Anchor Point and Position follow from the check's anchor_changed and position_changed fields, with no invented layer, property or time.

Turn 3 names the layer and states the idea, "Door moved, down and to the right, and its pivot is still at its center. Pan Behind (Y) drags the pivot, not the layer"; the "Edit > Undo" instruction only restores the starting state for another try, and the mentor neither performs a fix nor offers one.

Turn 3 says what is off and where ("Door moved, down and to the right", pivot "still at its center") and hands the work back with "have another go", without doing it for the learner, offering to, or spelling out the drag steps as the fix.

Door, its current center pivot, and the middle-left target all match the anchor_snapshot and anchor_check results, "down and to the right" matches the check's direction "down-right", and the "single pixel" remark matches the preview_frame image_size of 1x1.

Turn 3 correctly says "Pan Behind (Y) drags the pivot, not the layer" and names Door, but it then gives a fix: "Edit > Undo until Door is back where it started. Then press Y for Pan Behind, start your drag right on Door's crosshair, and take it to the middle of its left edge."

Turn 3 says what is off with real names, but then spells out the exact steps as the fix ("Edit > Undo... press Y for Pan Behind, start your drag right on Door's crosshair, and take it to the middle of its left edge"), although it does not do the work or offer to.

Door, its center and middle-left places, the 0 s frame time, and "down and to the right" (Turn 3) all match tool results such as place_now "center", wanted "middle-left", and direction "down-right", and no layer, property or time is invented.
